name: Meetings with nowhere to meet
title: Meetings with nowhere to meet: your meetings with guests and no place or call link, in the morning brief, with one press to add a Meet link

events.added: You pressed Add a Meet link on a meeting with nowhere to meet in the morning brief
events.put: You pressed Not needed on a meeting with nowhere to meet in the morning brief

runs.shown: Rouh put a meeting of yours with guests and no place or call link in the morning brief

permissions: reads your main calendar's meetings of the next three days each time the morning brief opens
adds a Google Meet link to one of your meetings only when you press Add a Meet link; Google tells its guests of the change
keeps the meetings you put away or gave a link in your own settings
